claim_ceiling: Design-contract consistency only. No runtime component activation, capability, efficiency, SOTA, or consciousness claim is supported.

source_binding.checkout_policy: The benchmark workflow must check out exactly the PR head SHA or dispatched commit SHA.

factors.enabled_mechanism: Symthaea native HDC/VSA representation and native associative operations
factors.disabled_control: Fixed-seed random projection with the same downstream interface and declared representation width

factors.enabled_mechanism: The nominated active-core CfC/LTC temporal model with explicit time intervals
factors.disabled_control: Parameter-matched GRU temporal comparator; also run memoryless and simple leaky-state controls in the temporal study

factors.enabled_mechanism: FEP-style policy selection with an explicit epistemic/information-seeking term
factors.disabled_control: Pragmatic-greedy action selection using the same environment, observation interface, and world-model interface

tasks.environment: Seeded partially observable T-maze or cue-conflict task with a costly information-gathering action
Seeded environment with a stable phase followed by a declared dynamics or reward change
Role-filler or sequence task with held-out compositions and declared corruption levels
Frozen time-series task with controlled missing observations and irregular elapsed-time intervals

baselines.scope: policy ablation with shared world-model interface
labelled upper bound only; never a deployable comparator or tuning signal

metrics.energy: Report only when measurement method, device, power limits, and aggregation are documented and reproducible.

analysis_plan.pairing: Pair environment seeds and scenarios across all factorial profiles and comparators.
analysis_plan.uncertainty: Report per-task effect sizes, variance across seeds, and 95% confidence intervals.
analysis_plan.multiplicity: Predeclare primary contrasts and apply Holm correction across registered primary tests.
analysis_plan.synergy: Do not infer synergy from the full profile alone; estimate preregistered factor interaction effects on held-out results.
analysis_plan.guardrails: A primary-score gain cannot compensate for a material increase in constraint violations, miscalibration, or false acceptance.
analysis_plan.internal_metrics: Phi-like and other internal measurements are exploratory secondary outcomes, not proxies for task competence or proof of consciousness.

hard_gates: All eight distinct profiles must be present exactly once.
Each disabled factor must have a named control adapter; runtime logs must prove the adapter actually ran.
A label or learning threshold alone is not evidence that computation or state evolution was disabled.
Exact source SHA, profile identity, task revision, seed/split, baseline identity, budget use, and result artifact digests must be recorded.
No test, hidden oracle, or held-out label may leak into the tested policy or its tuning process.
Incomplete execution, unmatched budgets, missing baselines, failed integrity checks, and invalid outputs are non-qualification states.
No SOTA or production-readiness claim can be emitted by the protocol validator.
